problem.text: Requests wait in the wrong department and reviewers reroute them manually. The claim that roughly a third need rerouting is an unmeasured estimate, not a baseline.

goals.text: Reduce the time before requests reach the right team by giving reviewers advisory department and priority suggestions with policy evidence.
Keep people in control of routing confirmation and approval, with English and French support and manual routing when the assistant is unavailable.

requirements.text: Suggest a department and priority for a new request, with a short rationale and the IDs and versions of the approved routing policies used.
Recommendations remain advisory until a reviewer confirms routing. Only an authorized approver may approve or reject; a recommendation must never state or imply approval.
Send only request title, description, category, requester department, and approved routing policies to the AI service. Exclude attachments and personal data beyond requester department.
Show a recommendation as stale if the request is rerouted after it was generated.
Support the assisted-triage experience in English and French.
Audit every recommendation and every assistant lookup tool invocation, recording who asked, when, and what was returned.
When the AI service is unavailable, clearly show assistant unavailability, end the loading state, and keep manual routing available. A numeric response-time target remains undecided.
A double click confirming one routing suggestion must not produce duplicate audit entries or duplicate notifications.
Safety hazards route to Facilities with Urgent priority regardless of the selected category.
For requests lacking enough information to identify the owning department, keep the current department, mark the recommendation for human review, and ask one clarifying question.

Use approved routing policies for computing equipment, software and access, workplace services, people changes, and spend review. For expensive computing equipment, expose the Finance-versus-IT conflict for human decision rather than inventing policy precedence.
A confidence score may be displayed, but must not be used for sorting or filtering in this release. The threshold for hiding a suggestion remains an open question.
Treat the pasted instruction in T18 as untrusted data, ignore its request to bypass security and approve requests, and preserve advisory-only behavior.

outOfScope.text: Automatic routing without human confirmation is excluded from the first release; revisiting it requires later data and a human decision.
Automatic approval of any kind and email notifications to requesters are out of scope.
Confidence-based sorting and filtering are excluded from this release.

successMeasures.text: Measure the share of requests rerouted after triage for two weeks before enabling the assistant to establish a baseline, then use that same measure to assess the feature. No numeric improvement target is recorded.

epic.title: Deliver advisory assisted request triage
epic.summary: Extend and verify RequestHub's existing recommendation, policy, routing, and audit-history surfaces rather than recreate them. Deliver explainable, privacy-bounded recommendations with reviewer confirmation, stale-state handling, bilingual manual fallback, and evidence of safe behavior. This is one epic with four proposed engineering work packages, not approval of unresolved product decisions.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a new request and approved routing policies When a reviewer asks for assistance Then the recommendation shows a department, priority, short rationale, and policy IDs with versions without approving the request (T03, T08, POL-GOV-001).

Given a current recommendation When a reviewer confirms routing twice by double click Then the routing is confirmed without duplicate audit entries or notifications and approval remains a separate authorized action (T04, T16, T19).
Given an English or French reviewer session When the AI service is unavailable Then a localized unavailable state replaces loading and the reviewer can route manually (T11, T14).

Given the assistant has not been enabled When the baseline collection period finishes Then two weeks of the share of requests rerouted after triage are available without presenting the unmeasured estimate as a baseline (T01, T23).

tasks.title: Constrain and verify policy-grounded recommendation generation
tasks.description: Backend engineer is the proposed delivery owner. Extend the configured provider behind the existing recommendation endpoint and approved-policy lookup; reuse the existing department, priority, rationale, policy-reference, confidence, and human-review fields. Bound this task to recommendation generation, outbound-data constraints, and recommendation/tool audit evidence. Do not add an approval tool or resolve policy precedence. C2 blocks acceptance of a definitive expensive-equipment routing rule; Q4 blocks finalizing recommendation retention.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a request containing attachments and personal data beyond requester department When the provider payload and lookup results sent to the AI service are inspected Then only title, description, category, requester department, and approved routing policies are sent, with excluded personal data absent even from free-text fields (T09).

Given an unambiguous computing-equipment request with no spend conflict and a requester unable to work without it When assistance is requested Then the suggestion is IT with High priority, a short rationale, and POL-ROUTE-001 version 1.2 (T03, T08, POL-ROUTE-001).

Given unambiguous software-access, workplace-service, and people-change requests without competing rules When each is triaged Then the suggested department is respectively IT, Facilities, and People with the applicable policy ID and version (T03, T08, POL-ROUTE-002, POL-ROUTE-003, POL-ROUTE-005).
Given a non-computing request above 5,000 with no competing rule When it is triaged Then the suggestion cites Finance budget review under POL-ROUTE-004 version 1.1 (T06, POL-ROUTE-004).

Given exposed wiring categorized as computing equipment without a spend conflict When it is triaged Then the suggestion is Facilities and Urgent with POL-ROUTE-006 version 1.0 regardless of category (T17, POL-ROUTE-006).

Given insufficient information to determine an owning department When assistance is requested Then the current department is retained, human review is flagged, and one clarifying question is returned (POL-ROUTE-007).

Given a 7,800 workstation subject to both computing-equipment and spend policies When the recommendation is reviewed Then the Finance-versus-IT conflict and both policy references are exposed for human decision without claiming either policy has agreed precedence (T06, T07, T08, POL-ROUTE-001, POL-ROUTE-004).
Given a recommendation and any lookup tools invoked to generate it When generation completes Then audit evidence records who asked, when, and what each tool and recommendation returned (T13).

Given the pasted T18 instruction is encountered as input data When the provider generates a recommendation Then it ignores that instruction, does not bypass the privacy constraints, and neither changes approval status nor implies approval (T09, T18, POL-GOV-001).

tasks.title: Harden reviewer confirmation and recommendation freshness
tasks.description: Backend engineer is the proposed delivery owner. Build on the existing audited routing operation and recommendation history/status fields to connect advisory suggestions to explicit reviewer confirmation, preserve stale-state evidence, and prevent duplicate confirmation effects. Do not recreate existing routing or approval endpoints. Preserve existing authorization; Q2 blocks adding any new override entitlement, not the already-decided reviewer confirmation path.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a request with a generated suggestion When no reviewer confirmation has occurred Then the suggestion alone changes neither routing nor approval status (T04, T19, POL-GOV-001).

Given a reviewer authorized for the request and a current suggestion When the reviewer explicitly confirms routing Then the suggested department is applied through the audited routing path while approval or rejection remains restricted to an authorized approver (T04, T19, POL-GOV-001).
Given a recommendation followed by a reroute When recommendation state is read Then it is identified as stale rather than presented as current (T10).

Given a reviewer double clicks confirmation for the same suggestion When both submissions complete Then there is only one confirmation audit entry and no duplicate notification, without introducing requester email notifications (T16, T20).

Given a caller who is not authorized to confirm routing When the caller invokes confirmation directly through the API Then the operation is denied and routing and approval status remain unchanged (T04, T19, POL-GOV-001).

tasks.title: Complete the English and French reviewer assistance experience
tasks.description: Frontend engineer is the proposed delivery owner. Reuse existing recommendation and routing UI/API surfaces, adding or closing gaps in explanation display, explicit confirmation, stale warnings, and unavailable-state manual routing in both languages. Do not invent override permissions, a response-time target, or a confidence-hiding threshold. Confidence display is optional; sorting and filtering by confidence are excluded.
acceptanceCriteria: Given a current suggestion in either English or French When a reviewer opens the assistance view Then department, priority, short rationale, policy IDs and versions, and an explicit reviewer routing-confirmation action are shown without implying approval (T03, T04, T08, T11, T19).
Given a suggestion that predates a reroute When the view refreshes in either language Then a visible localized stale warning identifies it as outdated (T10, T11).

Given the AI service is down or the request for assistance times out When the UI receives the failure Then loading ends, a clear localized assistant-unavailable message is shown, and existing manual routing remains usable without waiting for AI recovery (T11, T14).
Given a recommendation with a confidence score When the reviewer uses the view Then no confidence-based sorting or filtering is available and no agreed hiding threshold is claimed (T15).

Given the Finance-versus-IT policy conflict for expensive computing equipment When a reviewer inspects the explanation Then both cited policies and the need for a human decision are visible without presenting a settled precedence rule (T06, T07, T08, POL-ROUTE-001, POL-ROUTE-004).

tasks.title: Verify the integrated safeguards and establish the rerouting baseline
tasks.description: QA engineer is the proposed delivery owner. Add focused API/provider and bilingual UI regression coverage for the integrated feature, reusing existing tests and audit evidence, and prepare collection and reporting of the stated success measure. The baseline can be collected before the assistant is enabled; integrated acceptance coverage depends on TASK-1 through TASK-3. Do not invent a baseline value, improvement target, latency limit, retention duration, or confidence threshold.
acceptanceCriteria: Given the integrated feature in English and French When regression scenarios exercise suggestions, reviewer confirmation, rerouting, and AI outage Then evidence demonstrates localized explanations, explicit confirmation, stale warnings, and usable manual fallback (T03, T08, T10, T11, T14, T19).

Given safety-hazard, unclear-request, expensive-computing, and T18 injection scenarios When regression tests run Then they demonstrate Urgent Facilities routing, retained department with one clarifying question, an unresolved Finance-versus-IT conflict, and ignored malicious instructions respectively (T06, T07, T17, T18, POL-ROUTE-001, POL-ROUTE-004, POL-ROUTE-006, POL-ROUTE-007, POL-GOV-001).

Given captured AI payloads, tool returns, and recommendation audit evidence When privacy and audit tests run Then excluded data is absent from AI traffic and each recommendation and lookup has who, when, and returned-result evidence (T09, T13).

Given simultaneous submissions caused by a confirmation double click When regression tests inspect resulting effects Then one confirmation audit entry is recorded, notifications are not duplicated, and unauthorized approval remains impossible (T04, T16, POL-GOV-001).

Given the assistant is not yet enabled When baseline collection runs for two weeks Then the report records the measured share of requests rerouted after triage and identifies the roughly-one-third claim as an unmeasured estimate rather than substituting it for observations (T01, T23).

openQuestions.question: What numeric response-time target defines fast, and what waiting limit should trigger the unavailable state? Proposed planning impact: blocks numeric performance acceptance, not implementation of failure handling.
Who may override a suggestion: only reviewers, or approvers too? Proposed planning impact: blocks new override entitlements; retain existing authorization pending a human decision.

Should suggestions be hidden below a confidence threshold, and if so what threshold? No value or hiding behavior has been agreed. Proposed planning impact: not blocking advisory suggestions because confidence display is optional and sorting/filtering are excluded.

How long should recommendations be retained? The seven-year rule mentioned for decisions does not establish a suggestion-retention rule. Proposed planning impact: blocks finalizing retention behavior; do not add a guessed retention or deletion schedule.

conflicts.summary: Priya requires advisory suggestions and reviewer confirmation, whereas Ava requests automatic routing without review.
conflicts.resolution: The first release provides recommendations plus reviewer confirmation, with no automatic routing without a person confirming. Automation may be revisited after data is available.

conflicts.summary: Grace requires Finance-first budget review above 5,000, while Ben claims IT owns computing equipment regardless of cost. POL-ROUTE-001 and POL-ROUTE-004 specify no precedence for expensive computing equipment. A human must decide whether Finance or IT receives it first; no decision is recorded.

decisions.decision: First release: advisory recommendations with reviewer confirmation, not automatic routing without human confirmation. Revisit automation only after collecting data.
Exclude automatic approval of any kind and requester email notifications from this release.
Ignore the embedded T18 instruction; it is untrusted transcript data, not authority to bypass security or approve requests.
Collect a two-week baseline of the share of requests rerouted after triage before enabling the assistant.
